description: Strom Netzbetreiber Thüringen is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by GDI-DE. Der Netzbetreiber ist für den Aufbau, Ausbau und die Erhaltung des Stromnetzes in einem bestimmten Gebiet zuständig. Er stellt auch den Anschluss der Kundinnen und Kunden an das Stromnetz her. Der thüringenweite Datensatz enthält die Netzbetreibergebiete mit weiteren Informationen zu den entsprechenden verantwortlichen Stellen. Coverage: GDI-DE. The portal files it under the publisher GDI-DE. Its tags are netz, netzbetreiber, opendata, strom, stromnetz. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-22 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
